clue.text: A jolly atmosphere with companion in comfy seat

indicators.note: with companion in means the companion's letters sit inside the rest

parts.note: a jolly is old slang for a Royal Marine, abbreviated RM
atmosphere means air
CH stands for Companion of Honour

explanation.surface: A cheerful mood comes with having a friend beside you in a cosy chair.
explanation.definitionFit: A padded chair with side supports for the elbows is the classic comfortable seat.

clue.text: Told what votes were in close election

definitions.text: what votes were in close election

explanation.surface: A tale of ballots being checked again after a tight vote.
explanation.definitionFit: Told means narrated; in a tight poll the ballots are counted a second time.

clue.text: Highly-secure building where Salvationists meet

explanation.surface: A fortress doubling as the meeting hall of the Salvation Army.
explanation.walkthrough: Salvation Army halls are traditionally called citadels.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortress is a stronghold, and the Salvation Army names its meeting halls the same way.

clue.text: This prophet's pronouncement may be boring

indicators.note: the pronouncement of a word is how it sounds when said, so a soundalike is wanted

parts.note: an auger is a tool for boring holes

explanation.surface: A soothsayer's predictions might be tedious to listen to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boring' looks like a dull speech, but it describes a drilling tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A seer in ancient Rome who read omens and foretold events.

clue.text: Drive one away from wreckage

indicators.note: one away from wreckage means the letter for one is taken out of it

parts.note: wreckage means ruin
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Steer someone clear of a car crash.
explanation.definitionFit: To run someone somewhere is to give them a lift, to drive them.

clue.text: Material is loud, a sort of red mostly

parts.note: F stands for forte, loud in music

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: brick red is a shade of red

explanation.surface: A loud reddish cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric is cloth, a material for making clothes.

clue.text: Understanding fans?

explanation.surface: Grasping what a crowd of supporters is about.
explanation.definitionFit: If you are keeping up with an argument you are tracking it; a celebrity's fans make up their devotees.

clue.text: Stops holding guy's instruments

indicators.note: holding means one piece goes around the other

parts.note: stops means bans
Joe is a typical man's name, as guy means a fellow

explanation.surface: A man's musical instruments are confiscated.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of a stringed instrument with a round drum-like body, plucked in folk music.

clue.text: Bits of news in paper given an initial spin

indicators.note: a spin puts the letters of the newspaper's name into a new order

parts.note: The Times is a newspaper

explanation.surface: News stories in a paper are spun by the editor.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is not in the clue: the paper is The Times, whose letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate news stories or reports are called pieces or articles.

clue.text: Buzz off! is not half scornful

indicators.note: not half means only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: scathing means witheringly scornful

explanation.surface: Telling someone to go away is rather contemptuous.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation telling someone to go away, like shoo.

clue.text: Good 'un, David, when in action as user of weapon

parts.note: 'un is dialect for one, read as UN
David killed Goliath with a sling, so in action he was a slinger

explanation.surface: Praise for David, a fine fellow in a fight with his weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A Wild West gunman is someone handy with a pistol.

clue.text: Return money, professional estimates being halved

parts.note: a quid is a pound in British slang
pro is short for professional

indicators.note: being halved means only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: quotes are price estimates

explanation.surface: Getting money back when a professional's quotes are cut in half.
explanation.definitionFit: Something given in return for something else, a Latin phrase for an exchange.

clue.text: Nervous by virtue of being presented to monarch

parts.note: qua is Latin for in the capacity of, by virtue of being
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: Someone feels anxious about being presented at court.
explanation.definitionFit: Trembling with fear, as a nervous person shakes.

clue.text: Put out old books with useless content

indicators.note: with useless content means the other letters go inside the books

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, the old books of the Bible
US is short for unserviceable, useless

explanation.surface: Throwing away old books whose content is worthless.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel or drive out, as one ousts a rival.

clue.text: American city is home to a classically fast runner

indicators.note: is home to means the city contains the next piece

parts.note: Atlanta is the capital of Georgia, USA

explanation.surface: A US city hosts a speedy athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this huntress was the swift runner beaten by golden apples.

clue.text: Instrument that could make snout feel odd?

indicators.note: odd suggests the letters are in a strange order and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A musical device that would give your nose a funny sensation.
explanation.definitionFit: A wind instrument blown through the nostrils, found in Polynesia.

clue.text: Contemptible type that may be attracted to a website?

definitions.text: that may be attracted to a website?

explanation.surface: A low person drawn to an internet page.
explanation.walkthrough: Read website as web site: a spider's web catches flies.
explanation.definitionFit: A bug is a term of contempt for a lowly person, and bugs get caught in spiders' webs.

clue.text: Girl I introduced to comfort knight

indicators.note: introduced to means put inside the following word

parts.note: to comfort is to cheer
Val is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl and I go to console a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: A French title for a knight or member of an order.

clue.text: Awfully mad fool that may be targeted 'by commercials

indicators.note: awfully suggests the letters are badly jumbled

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: Advertisers chase a madly foolish audience.
explanation.definitionFit: The mass public viewed as a target audience for advertising.

clue.text: Performer's attire's specially tailored

indicators.note: specially tailored suggests the letters are remade into a new shape

explanation.surface: An entertainer's costume is custom-made.
explanation.definitionFit: A professional entertainer such as a singer or dancer.

clue.text: Artist scoffing at unappreciative people

indicators.note: scoffing means eating up, so the artist swallows the next word

parts.note: Ingres was a French painter

explanation.surface: A painter mocking ungrateful people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scoffing' suggests mockery, but here it means gobbling, so a container.
explanation.definitionFit: Ungrateful people who show no thanks.

clue.text: One may run two articles without sanction

indicators.note: without means outside, so the articles go round the next piece

parts.note: a and the are the two articles
to let is to allow or sanction

explanation.surface: A sprinter competes without official approval.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner, as a sportsperson who competes in races.

clue.text: Keen interest, but it's a bit of a lemon

explanation.surface: Eagerness compared with a sour fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto or relish; also the outer peel of a citrus fruit.

clue.text: Chosen to be priest, having overcome first couple of temptations

indicators.note: having overcome means placed on top in this down clue

parts.note: Eli was the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible

indicators.note: first couple of means the first two letters are taken

explanation.surface: A man resists temptation to become a priest.
explanation.definitionFit: The select few, the picked group.

clue.text: Nominal leader's bust

explanation.surface: A leader in name only appears as a sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: A leader with no real power; also a carved bust on a ship's prow.

clue.text: Approach game with exalted humour

parts.note: RU is rugby union

indicators.note: exalted means raised up, so in a down clue the word is read upwards

parts.note: a pun is a kind of humour

explanation.surface: Coming to a game in high spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: The approach or lead-in to an event.

clue.text: American to pine for the Scot we know and love?

parts.note: to pine for means to miss

parts.words: the Scot we know and love
parts.note: Ian is a Scottish name, and our Ian is the one we know and love

explanation.surface: Longing for a beloved Scotsman abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of a US state on the Mississippi.

clue.text: I am initiator of pranks

parts.note: I'm is a contraction of I am

indicators.note: initiator of means the first letter

explanation.surface: A little devil boasts of starting jokes.
explanation.definitionFit: A mischievous sprite who starts tricks.

clue.text: Lover no longer has appeal farewell!

parts.note: an ex is a former lover
it means sex appeal

explanation.surface: A former lover loses appeal and says goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: A departure or way out, the act of leaving.

clue.text: Paul — clergyman ignoring his last two letters

indicators.note: ignoring his last two letters means the final pair of the title is dropped

parts.note: a reverend is a clergyman

explanation.surface: A minister with letters after his name.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul is the American patriot whose midnight ride warned of British troops.

clue.text: Favourite lines are given to the dog in Punch and Judy act

indicators.note: are given to means placed after

parts.note: a pup is a young dog
a pet is a favourite
RY is railway

explanation.surface: A dog's favourite lines are in a puppet show.
explanation.definitionFit: The art of performing with puppets, as in a seaside show.
